text:
mara: FYI — we're proposing a small SDK change next week: add an explicit routing header + flip the telemetry opt-in default to "opted_in" for new installs. This touches Python/TS/Go. want feedback before we push.
sam: wait, flipping opt-in default will be breaking for privacy-focused customers. can we make it opt-out instead? @mara
mara: good call. proposal is: new installs opt-in, existing installs unchanged unless they upgrade. we'll include an env var override and a console toggle per-org. thoughts?
jason: per-org toggle in console is 👍. ops teams will want to opt-out org-wide. we should surface migration logs in the console dashboard so customers see who opted in.
li: SDK-wise, adding a header is non-breaking if we make it optional. but some firewall rules might block unknown headers. suggest header name `x-rwd-routing-policy` and add a config option `client.routing_header_enabled`.
anika: +1 for opt-in-by-default on upgrades. but we need a migration plan doc + changelog. also update the Quickstarts.
sam: can we avoid a major semver bump for Go? go modules are picky about API surface changes.
go-sdk-bot: go-sdk: propose adding `WithRoutingHeader(bool)` option to existing client builder. no exported types changed.
li: that sounds safe. for TS/Python, we can add a `routingHeader` flag to client `init` options. include example in README.
mara: minimal code snippet for python that we'll add to docs:

```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'], routing_header=True)
```

and TS:

```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, routingHeader: true })
```

jason: please ensure we log this in the audit trail: who toggled org-level opt-in.
anika: dashboard UX: add a small banner during rollout that explains perf vs privacy tradeoffs and a one-click revert. don't hide it under advanced settings.
mara: agreed. also we need to add a telemetry consent checkbox to the onboarding flow for new orgs.
sam: what about quotas? if routing header causes requests to route to cheaper model variants, customer's unit cost may change. should warn in console estimation.
li: we can add an estimated cost delta in the rollout modal based on historical usage patterns. backend work needed to simulate routing rules though.
mara: action items: (1) eng-platform to add console toggle + audit logs (2) SDKs to add toggles and env var `REDWOOD_ROUTING_HEADER=true` (3) docs + migration guide (4) product to prepare onboarding copy. assign owners?
jason: i'll take (1) with @anika for UX.
anika: i'll draft the modal copy and banner.
li: i'll open PRs for TS/Python/Go with the flag and tests.
go-sdk-bot: created draft branch go-sdk/routing-header-optin
deploy-bot: created jira RWD-2345 "SDK routing header + telemetry onboarding" and linked draft branch.
mara: timeline: merge SDK PRs by EOD Wednesday, console toggle by Friday, gradual rollout next week with monitoring. we'll hold if any customer raises blocking concerns. thanks all :thumbsup:
sam: please add a short rollback runbook in the ticket.
jason: will do — adding health checks and canary config to the rollout checklist.
li: quick note: include sample cURL for manual testing:

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "x-rwd-routing-policy: prefer-low-cost" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'

mara: perfect. I'll collate and push a short RFC to the repo after lunch. if nobody objects by EOD, we proceed with the plan.
